• Permanent position available with a considerable portfolio of works for the next 5+ years
  • To build your career by assisting in the delivery of ‘leading edge’ engineering projects.
  • To work with a vibrant, agile and multi-functional team in delivering projects on time, safely, to budget and to the required quality standards.
  • To benefit from Kirby’s Career Development Programmes that will enhance your leadership capability.
  • To work with the best.
  • Excellent package on offer with room for negotiations

About Kirby Group Engineering

Kirby Group Engineering is an international multi-disciplinary engineering services contractor and leading provider of high-value engineering services to a number of ‘blue chip’ companies. Operating across Ireland, the UK, Europe and South Africa, Kirby has become the engineering service provider of choice in growth segments such as pharmaceuticals, data centres and power transmission and distribution. Our culture is innovative, collaborative and performance focused. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to developing talent and rewarding performance.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our growing Power & Renewables team. Reporting to the Operations/Contracts Manager, you will take full responsibility for the successful delivery of complex projects from pre-construction through to commissioning and handover. You will lead project teams to deliver outstanding results across health & safety, programme, quality, commercial performance, and client satisfaction, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of Power & Renewables projects.
  • Develop and manage project execution strategies, programmes, resources, and delivery plans.
  • Ensure projects are delivered safely, in compliance with all HSE requirements and company standards.
  • Take ownership of project budgets, cost control, contract administration, variations, and overall commercial performance.
  • Manage project risks and opportunities, implementing mitigation plans where required.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, acting as the primary point of contact throughout project delivery.
  • Oversee subcontractors, procurement activities, and supply chain performance to ensure successful project outcomes.
  • Coordinate closely with engineering, commercial, quality, and site teams to drive efficient delivery.
  • Monitor project progress, provide accurate reporting, and escalate key risks or issues when necessary.
  • Lead project review meetings and ensure lessons learned are captured and implemented across future projects.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree-qualified in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline or hold a recognised electrical trade qualification.
  • Professional qualification such as PMP, PRINCE2, APM PMQ, or equivalent is desirable.
  • Minimum 5 years' experience delivering HV Power and Renewable-related projects, such as BESS and substations
  • Demonstrable experience delivering projects safely, on programme, and within budget.
  • Strong understanding of project planning, commercial management, contract administration, and risk management.
  • Strong knowledge of construction health, safety, and environmental requirements.
  • Full driving licence and willingness to travel to project locations across Ireland.

What We're Looking For

The successful candidate will be a confident leader with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of motivating teams and driving performance in a fast-paced environment. You will possess strong commercial awareness, sound decision-making abilities, and a proven track record of successfully delivering complex infrastructure projects while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and client service.

For more information on this role, or other Construction / Engineering opportunities across Ireland, the UK, Europe, or South Africa please review our careers page (Vacancies - Kirby Group Careers) or contact the Talent Acquisition Team at Kirby Group in confidence on +353 (0)1 454 0411.

Kirby Group Engineering is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of race, gender, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or age.

Job Description

DePuy Synthes is recruiting for a Data Platform Manager located in Raynham, Massachusetts; New Brunswick, New Jersey; Palm Beach Gardens, Florida; Indianapolis, Indiana; Warsaw, Indiana; Cork, Ireland

Please note that this role may be available across multiple countries and may be posted under different requisition numbers to align with local requirements. Candidates should apply to the posting aligned with their preferred location.

Ireland: R-105879

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/.

Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopedics business to establish a standalone orthopedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The planned separation is subject to legal requirements, regulatory approvals, and other customary conditions and approvals.

Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. Details of any planned changes would be provided at an appropriate time and subject to any vital consultation processes.

What's in it for you?

As a Data Platform Manager, you will own the strategy, architecture, engineering standards, and roadmap for the modern data platform that enables trusted data products, digital applications, analytics, and AI across Orthopedics. You will lead the Data Foundation initiative to overhaul the current data ecosystem and establish a scalable lakehouse using Databricks, cloud services, and medallion architecture.

You will create reusable ingestion, transformation, testing, governance, and observability capabilities that allow teams to onboard data and deliver business-ready products consistently and efficiently. You will also provide technical leadership for business separation activities, ensuring platform continuity and alignment with future-state interpersonal needs.

This role combines strategic platform ownership with hands-on technical leadership, people and vendor management, and multi-functional partnership. If you are energized by building reusable platform capabilities and turning strategy into measurable business outcomes, this is an opportunity to make a substantial impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and implement the Data Platform and Data Foundation strategy, target architecture, roadmap, engineering standards, and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead the design and evolution of a scalable Databricks lakehouse using medallion architecture, reusable data products, and cloud-native services.
  • Design, build, and scale reusable, metadata-driven data ingestion and data pipeline frameworks, including batch and streaming patterns, source onboarding, transformation, orchestration, schema evolution, auditability, and embedded data-quality controls.
  • Establish platform engineering standards for data modeling, code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, security, performance, cost efficiency, and production readiness.
  • Design and implement the data engineering governance framework in partnership with Data Governance, embedding ownership, business definitions, policy controls, architecture reviews, data quality, certification, lineage, and traceability into engineering workflows and data products.
  • Implement end-to-end data observability and operational governance, including monitoring, reliability, service-level expectations, incident prevention, and lifecycle management.
  • Enable analytics and AI teams with governed, reusable, and AI-ready data while maintaining alignment with the Enterprise AI Platform and business digital-product teams.
  • Provide technical governance and architectural oversight for business separation and transition activities, protecting continuity while enabling independent future-state platforms.
  • Translate sophisticated business and digital-product needs into platform capabilities, manageable work packages, delivery roadmaps, and outcome-based execution plans.
  • Lead internal engineers and delivery partners; set technical direction, review solution quality, dependencies and risks, and build sustainable internal capability.

Qualifications

Education: A minimum of a Bachelor’s degree and/or equivalent University degree is required; a focused degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Information Systems or a related field is preferred. Masters degree preferred

Required

Experience and Skills:

  • Minimum of six (6) years of relevant professional work experience
  • Multifaceted experience in data engineering or data platforms, including in technical leadership, people management, or platform ownership roles.
  • Validated experience in leading the design, implementation, or modernization of a data platform or lakehouse and converting strategy into an executable roadmap.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Databricks, PySpark, Spark SQL, Python, SQL, Delta Lake, and cloud data services, with Azure and/or AWS experience.
  • Demonstrated experience designing reusable ingestion and data pipeline frameworks, including orchestration and integration with dbt, Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, or comparable tools.
  • Strong knowledge of data architecture and modeling, including dimensional modeling, star and snowflake schemas.
  • Experience defining and implementing automated testing strategies for data engineering code and pipelines, including unit, integration, regression, reconciliation, data-quality testing, and CI/CD integration.
  • Experience establishing engineering governance, coding standards, release controls, documentation expectations, architecture reviews, and production-readiness practices for distributed data teams.
  • Experience implementing data observability across pipelines and products, including monitoring, lineage, reliability, alerting, and service-level management.
  • Experience leading distributed teams and governing external vendors or managed-service partners against architecture standards, quality expectations, achievements, and business outcomes.
  • Ability to communicate sophisticated platform concepts to technical and business collaborators and influence decisions in a matrixed organization.

Preferred

  • Experience with Fivetran or similar managed data integration and change-data-capture platforms.
  • Experience building a data platform that supports federated business teams, self-service analytics, certified data products, and AI-ready consumption patterns.
  • Familiarity with end-to-end supply chain domains such as planning, manufacturing, procurement, quality, and distribution within MedTech or another regulated industry.
  • Knowledge of enterprise systems of record such as ERP, MES, PLM, and planning platforms, including experience modernizing fragmented or legacy data environments.
  • Experience integrating a data platform with Power BI, semantic models, data marketplaces or catalogs, and AI/ML platforms.
  • High-level understanding of web and digital application architecture, APIs, integration patterns, and vendor-led application delivery.
  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar tools to accelerate development, automate repetitive work, and improve engineering quality.
  • Experience supporting Agile product teams, mentoring engineers, and building reusable platform capabilities embraced across multiple business functions.

Other

  • This is a hybrid position. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite 1 to 3 days per week and may be required to travel up to 20% domestically and internationally.

job.description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

What the Project Is About

Data centres are becoming some of Europe's most consequential and fastest-growing electricity users, yet most still appear to the grid as large, opaque, and largely grid-agnostic loads. AIRCAS, short for AI-driven Resource & Cooling forCASting and control for data centres, gives you the opportunity to change this through advanced AI control in a live data-centre environment. You will help build a digital twin, forecasting, and safety-constrained control system that coordinates electricity demand, cooling, heat recovery, and water use.

At HPE Labs Ireland, the role will involve live telemetry processing, research, training, evaluation, and deployment of reinforcement-learning controllers across two MODPODs in the Customer Innovation Centre (CIC) data centre. You will validate control policies through replay, hardware-in-the-loop, shadow-mode, and controlled live trials. This is an applied research role spanning physical-system modelling, software engineering, machine learning, and operational deployment.

You will collaborate with our international project partners: the University of Porto, CNRS, Savery Tech, RWTH Aachen, Swerim, TerraBarrier, and Daikin Applied.

The Opportunity

Hewlett Packard Labs is seeking a highly qualified, self-motivated machine-learning and AI researcher to join its growing AI research team in Ireland. The role will accelerate research on digital twins that incorporate machine learning, with a focus on the AIRCAS programme.

You will develop and deploy advanced reinforcement-learning control for a live data-centre environment. The work spans research, software engineering, and experimental validation: from data collection and physical-system modelling through forecasting, control-policy training, hardware-in-the-loop testing, shadow operation, and bounded live trials.

What You Will Do

  • Build the CIC data and workload pipeline, including controlled workload generation, telemetry ingestion, time-series data management, data-quality checks, and baseline datasets.
  • Develop modular digital-twin software that combines site telemetry with physical models, empirical performance maps, cooling and storage models, and operational constraints.
  • Develop probabilistic forecasts for IT load, cooling demand, and relevant water and heat signals using CIC operational data.
  • Research, implement, train, and evaluate objective-shifting multi-objective reinforcement-learning policies that balance flexibility, cost, carbon, water use, and durability within hard safety limits.
  • Implement a price-response interface that produces feasible, auditable flexibility commitments with uncertainty information.
  • Validate the control stack through replay, hardware-in-the-loop testing, shadow mode, and controlled actuation windows on the CIC MODPODs.
  • Produce reproducible evidence for flexibility, reliability, sustainability, and durability performance, including measurement-and-verification workflows and KPI analysis.
  • Collaborate with HPE Labs researchers and the AIRCAS partners to integrate laboratory cooling results, sustainability signals, and physical operating guardrails into the control system.

About Hewlett Packard Labs And AIRL

Hewlett Packard Labs is HPE's central research organisation. Its purpose is to deliver breakthrough technologies that create a competitive advantage for HPE, investing in fundamental areas of strategic interest and preparing resulting technologies for adoption.

The AI Research Lab (AIRL) focuses on applied machine-learning research and applications relevant to HPE and its customers. Its work includes reinforcement learning for sustainability, digital twins, complex scientific applications such as fusion energy, large language models, trustworthy and responsible AI, and data foundations for AI. The team brings together diverse skills and expertise to explore ambitious research and technology opportunities.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a machine-learning research engineer with experience in machine learning, time-series analysis, reinforcement learning, and digital twins. The role requires strong engineering judgement and an aptitude for modelling physical systems. Description

AWS Lambda’s goal is nothing less than to simplify and improve the experience of computing in the cloud for every developer on the planet, from start-ups to the largest Fortune 100 companies. Serverless computing is rapidly changing how every company thinks about building and delivering software solutions, and Lambda is leading this industry wide effort.

Our Team

AWS Lambda is growing its initiatives in Dublin, Ireland, with goals of continuing to define the Serverless revolution. Lambda teams in Dublin are part of lambda experience charter with mission to simplify the developer, operator, and administrator tasks in bringing code from desktop-development to a production service. If you’re excited by Serverless computing, programming languages and container/function interaction models, this role is for you. Join us and change how the world computes by enabling new frameworks that enable customers to build better software on top of AWS.

Lambda Experience Runtimes is one of the most customer visible and developer commented upon areas of Lambda. The Language Runtimes team are responsible for the curation, patching and deprecation of all the six Managed Runtimes that Lambda supports such as Python, NodeJS, Java, Ruby, Go, DotNet in addition to the custom runtime plus the associated lambda container images.

An ideal candidate has experience delivering new initiatives and be comfortable working closely with Customers. You should be aware of industry best practices & patterns in all aspects of building, releasing & verifying software. You should also be familiar with industry trends in programming languages, build tooling, and deployment spaces. You will own and help driving exciting new and existing initiatives in Lambda, while being capable of working on massive scale, high availability, and ambiguous performance problems as well as developer experience problems. This role will involve identifying and solving problems in different programming language ecosystems, enabling new customer facing functionality, and new programming paradigms in the Serverless ecosystem.

What does it take to succeed in this role?

A roll-up-your-sleeves type. Comfortable working in an environment dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of customers. Able to think about business opportunities, operational issues, and architectural diagrams in the course of a single conversation. Intellectually curious, always looking to learn, and a dedication to turning developers into fans. Someone who makes the team both productive and a fun place to work. Being excited to learn from others while bringing your own novel capabilities and perspectives.

On-Call Responsibility

This position involves on-call responsibilities, every builder on Lambda is also an owner. Nobody likes to get paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are well engineered, fault tolerant and meet a high quality bar before the go into production. Our customers expect nothing less. When we do get paged we work together as a team to resolve the root cause of the issue and nobody is left on their own to deal with an operational issue.

What you should expect?

If you’re excited by defining how modern and future software applications are built and want to help lead from the innovative edge, we guarantee that your work in our team will be ground-breaking and challenging. We’re looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we’ve been building.

Together, we’ll deliver the next generation of industry-leading compute features and help every business from the smallest startups to the largest enterprises run their code in the cloud without the burden of infrastructure or scale (that’s our job). We’ll shape not just our own products, but contribute to the direction of AWS and the serverless industry.

Utility Computing (UC)

AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) roles engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Come help us change the world!

Job location is Dublin, Ireland. Relocation assistance available. For more information on Amazon Web Services, please visit http://aws.amazon.com

About The Team

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
  • Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
  • Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. About The Role

In this role, you will support the planning, execution, and delivery of technical and regulatory-driven initiatives across engineering teams. You will manage end-to-end delivery, ensure alignment across teams, track dependencies, and proactively remove blockers. Working in an Agile/Scrum environment, you will help run team ceremonies, maintain roadmaps, monitor progress, and drive continuous improvement.

You will collaborate closely with engineering managers and subject matter experts to define scope, manage resources, and sequence work for optimal execution. Clear communication is essential, as you will handle updates, run effective meetings, and present timelines, risks, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Drive the planning and delivery of engineering projects and technology initiatives.
  • Work closely with Scrum/Agile teams to manage priorities, timelines and dependencies.
  • Coordinate work across multiple teams and ensure projects stay on track.
  • Identify and remove blockers, risks and dependencies that could impact delivery.
  • Work with Engineering Managers to agree resources, priorities and delivery milestones.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies, meetings and retrospectives.
  • Continuously look for ways to improve processes, team efficiency and delivery.
  • Provide clear updates on progress, risks, actions, timelines and dependencies.
  • Build strong relationships with engineers, managers and wider stakeholders.

About You

  • Strong Technical Project management exposure.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Confident communicator who can lead discussions, provide clarity, and drive outcomes.
  • Basic technical understanding is helpful but not required; ability to work with engineering teams is important.
  • Interest in payments, compliance, and regulatory work.
  • Experience with Agile delivery (sprints, releases, dependency management, backlog work).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; experience with BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Domo) is a plus.

Department: Access Office

Vacancy ID: 044663

The Role

Maynooth University is committed to a strategy in which the primary University goals of excellent research and scholarship and outstanding education are interlinked and equally valued. Our greatest impact on society is through inspiring and educating creative, inquisitive and critically engaged minds. We have a reputation for authentic, strengths-based access initiatives, supporting participation, engagement, and progression for all students.

We recognise that individual student needs vary greatly and that in addition to our universal student supports, dedicated support for complex additional needs is hugely beneficial in ensuring student success. Our Maynooth Access Programme (MAP) Student Advisory service is a key part of how we support the access, retention, and success of students from groups identified in the National Access Plan 2022 -2028 (NAP) as having low participation in higher education. These groups include students from socio-economically disadvantaged backgrounds, mature students, further education award holders, lone parents, refugees and protection applicants, care-experienced students, students with disabilities, and members of the Traveller and Roma communities.

We are seeking a Widening Participation Data Analyst who will have responsibility for supporting the identification, gathering, analysis and presentation of relevant widening participation student data/statistical reports related to National Access Plan target groups (outreach, access, progression, retention) to support university strategy, benchmarking, process monitoring, decision making and evidence-informed policy and practice. The post will play a key role in strengthening institutional capacity for monitoring, impact measurement and reporting, working across the Access Office, Institutional Research and Data Office, and Access/EDI structures.

Reporting to the MAP Strategic Development Manager within the Maynooth Access Programme (MAP) the Widening Participation Data Analyst will be based in the Maynooth Access Office as part of a multidisciplinary team that includes outreach and student support professionals, clinical and technical specialists, and administrative staff.

Late applications will not be accepted.

job.description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
  • Build AI-powered product experiences. Work with product teams to identify high-impact opportunities where AI can transform the user experience for millions—and then build these transformative solutions. Drive the process from possibility to production, delivering code that’s robust, reproducible, and built for scale.
  • Amplify your impact with AI. Integrate the most powerful AI tools directly into your development workflow—design, implementation, testing, and documentation—to move faster while maintaining high standards for correctness, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Master your toolkit. Work across diverse stacks with end-to-end ownership, choosing the right technologies for each challenge. From monoliths to microservices, gRPC to REST, Kubernetes to Docker, Python to Rust—you’ll apply technologies thoughtfully, focusing on depth and purpose rather than trends.
  • Build software that matters. Take real ownership from idea to production, creating systems used by millions and evolving them into products at scale.
  • Simplify relentlessly. Question every layer of complexity. Improve architectures, pipelines, and codebases to build systems that are simpler, more scalable, and easier to maintain.

What we look for
  • Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
  • Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
  • Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
  • Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offer
  • Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
  • An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
  • All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
  • A flexible start date and part-time options. You don't need to wait until graduation to apply. We offer flexible start dates and the possibility to begin part-time, transitioning to full-time as you complete your degree. Many Spooners joined before graduating and progressively took on greater responsibility, with arrangements that allowed them to do so without compromising their education.
  • Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland).

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. Responsibilities
In ADSO, we are the EMEA AI Data Service and Operations team under TikTok Product (abbreviation: ADSO), mainly providing safety and non-safety data annotation services and search operation services for all of the company's international products, which can also help international products build their own data ecological security.

To eliminate any doubt, this role involves reading, viewing, listening and examining user-generated content to ensure they comply with community guidelines. Content includes images, video, text related to every day life, but they can also include (but are not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child abuse; sexual assault; torture; bestiality; self-harm; suicide; murder. It is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis.

- Perform daily operational tasks such as quality inspection, guidelines and process optimization, queue assignment, and handling escalations for the evaluation project.
- Work closely with stakeholders to stay updated on guideline developments and provide feedback on implementation and execution.
- Conduct daily audits on an internal system and provide error analysis and feedback to stakeholders (R&D & Product Manager).
- Monitor the quality scores of evaluators and conduct root cause analysis with the management team.
- Monitor project data, record daily output and quality scores, prepare data analysis/reports for projects, and validate reports and data provided to stakeholders/partners.
- Localize the guidelines and design training schedules and coordinate and liaise with key stakeholders to ensure the successful go-live within the targeted timeframe.
- Deliver process/product/guideline training to new joiners.
- Play a role in setting up product knowledge tests, sharing result analysis, and working with key stakeholders to improve the product knowledge of the team.
- Able to work with sensitive content including but not limited to child exploitation, diverse religious and political perspectives, violence, and adult/sexual content. (Not frequent)
- Perform any other duties as reasonably required to support the role.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent education/experience.
- Fluency in Swahili is required as the role requires communication with Swahili markets, fluent in English is also required as it is the working language.
- Work experience in search engines and social media platforms; Former experience in Search relevant business.
- Experience in cross functional work and stakeholder management.
- Experience in analysis and communication skills with a good sense of flexibility.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in project management, project operation, or familiarity with users' Internet usage habits.

job.description: Data centres powering modern artificial intelligence workloads currently account for more than 2% of global electricity consumption, a figure projected to rise substantially over the next decade. In hyperscale facilities, around 30% of input electrical energy is lost as heat during power conversion and distribution. To address the power conversion challenges outlined in the UK’s Clean Power 2030, Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) that combine wide-bandgap power semiconductors and high-frequency magnetics offer the power density, efficiency, and bidirectional power-flow control required for AI data centres, megawatt-scale electric vehicle charging, and renewable-rich distribution networks. Research Aims & Scope This PhD project focuses on developing medium-voltage SST cells tailored for hyperscale AI data centres and net-zero grids. You will investigate the core physical challenges of high-frequency power conversion, focusing on designing compact, ultra-efficient magnetic links and mitigating electrical-thermal degradation under repetitive high-dv/dt stresses. Leveraging the supervisory team’s established research in advanced power semiconductors, sensing and gate-driving technologies, your work will combine multi-physics finite-element modelling (ANSYS/COMSOL) with experimental validation in our high-voltage power electronics laboratory, culminating in a scaled hardware prototype demonstrating enhanced efficiency and power density. The Research Environment Dr Jiaqi Yan and Prof. Layi Alatise will supervise the student at the University of Warwick, working within our world-class power electronics facilities. This project offers a unique opportunity to master the intersection of power semiconductors and high-voltage engineering, directly contributing to the UK's capability in next-generation energy infrastructure. Scholarship: The award will cover the UK tuition fee level, plus a tax-free stipend, currently £21,805, paid at the prevailing UKRI rate for 3.5 years of full-time study. International candidates are welcome to apply, but must be able to cover the difference in the fee levels. Eligibility: Essential: - A first-class or strong upper second-class degree (or equivalent) in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline. - Hands-on experience in power electronic devices/systems or high-voltage setups. Solid theoretical foundation in power electronics, power semiconductor devices, or high-voltage engineering. Desirable: Experience in multi-physics simulation tools (ANSYS, COMSOL), high-speed PCB design, embedded DSP/FPGA control, or other related skills How to apply: Interested candidates should submit a full formal application through https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/sci/eng/postgraduate/funding/jy/ Informal enquiry is also welcome.

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do. Who you'll work with Arista Networks is looking for Graduate Engineers interested in learning world leading product development in C/C++, Go and other languages. Join us at Arista Networks advancing the Software Defined Networking (SDN) revolution. What You’ll Do Writing Linux user space and kernel code to allow 32-bit drivers to DMA 64-bit virtual memory spaces using both Intel and AMD IOMMU controller. Working on the hardware/software boundary for chips and the kernel. Where an x86 chip might have tens of registers, you will routinely work on ASICs with thousands of registers, tables, and special TCAM memories. You will program networking chips to provide latency analysis and keep accurate counts of events happening billions of times per second. You will write Python to bootstrap new hardware. You will build software agents that mediate and translate between the requirements of switching ASICs, high capacity custom FPGAs, media adapters, and PCIe bridges. You might tune lasers and measure and correct error rates measured in parts per billion. Implementing communications protocols between routers and switches at layer 2 (such as LLDP, 802.1x, BFD, etc), and layer 3 (such as BGP, OSPF, ISIS). Updating the forwarding state of the hardware, using platform-independent abstractions. Reconciling the linux kernel routing model with the switch's forwarding state. Implementing a policy language used for filtering and manipulating routing data received and advertised to peers Accessing ASIC registers over SPI bus, SMbus, PCIe and I2C, to implement high resolution timers (sub-100ns accuracy) and read ASIC hardware specifications to gather near-real-time information on large numbers of packet flows and to generate network congestion statistics. Developing configuration management services using Go and Python to support YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF and RESTCONF over gRPC, ssh and ssl for standardised switch configuration, combined with tools such as git, gerrit, Jenkins, Slack and Trello. Developing routing protocol agents (for BGP, OSPF, ISIS) in C/C++ within a Fedora Linux embedded environment. Coding of fault-tolerant, concurrent agents capable of handling the demands of future data centres where high performance and high availability are basic requirements. Fully automated, developer owned, Python based, continuous test harness with 100s of devices under test at any one moment. #LI-EO1 Any of the following:- C, C++, Java, Python, Go, react.js, redux.js, node.js Networking, Linux Embedded Systems, Algorithms, Programming, Software Development. The working hours will be agreed in advance with the team manager.
